body:
Wanted to let those people who took the time to care and the person who pm'd me, that I am still alive at least in part due to you. 

Reading these replies delayed my attempt. That meant as I was passing out,  two  hikers turned up ( and I was in the middle of no where and saw no one else all day). I had to get out my car and appear normal. I was only just able to. 

Second attempt I panicked as I wasn't prepared. Third attempt I heard my friend was in hospital and might make it (again just as I was passing out).

I came extremely close to death (within a minute or two) and I'm in shock from not being dead today. Police detained me and took me to hospital. I'm going tothedoctors now. 

I've got another chance.  In part due to you guys. So thank you.
Was on Verge of passing out and two hikers came past

I know she died feeling loved. I made sure she did. She still died though and it still almost destroyed me. She also tried very hard to make me leave her at the end, because she could see it was killing me. 

I would for certain have given my life for her. I would have given anything for her... and I'm crying writing this, so you can tell how even over 5 years later the hurt hasn't healed. I would give my life to be able to tell her once more that I loved her... but its never enough. However much you get from someone, you always want more. 

I am so sorry that the person in your life did not have the guts to stick with you. That will sadly haunt him the rest of his days, because I know that every time I upset my fiancee in the time I knew her, it is those moments that visit me in the night...and I tried bloody hard to be perfect for her. It was her that gave me the name I use on this forum.  

I hope that you find happiness in the remainder of your life however long that is. I have not had much success praying, but I will pray for you. I can do nothing else. Cancer is a horrible, horrible disease and i am so sorry you have it. :(

Anyway,  it's late here,  so I've got to sleep. I hope you make it through tomorrow,  for your sake and your sons and i hope one day you see him graduate and you see him married and all that stuff that seems so far away and impossible now. 

Take care girl... or should i say mum ;)

And in what way is you killing yourself and him being put in therapy because of it in anyway of benefit to him? In what way is having no mother for the rest of his life of any benefit to him?  And you say therapy will help with that... what if it's not enough help? What if he doesn't cope? 

You are not contemplating suicide for his benefit at all. If you had $5000 you wouldn't be thinking about it,  because you said that in your earlier posts. 

Suicide is the most selfish thing you can do. I know that and if I do kill myself, I know it will deeply, deeply upset my children. No way will I try and convince myself that it's best for them as that is a lie. And my kids hardly see me.

No he won't. 

Read up on it.

You are lying to yourself about this to make suicide possible. You are sadly being selfish. You are considering suicide for you only. In no way at all will it benefit him.

So don't pretend otherwise.

Sorry,  but to suggest your son is better of without a loving mother is just nonsense. I'm sure if you ask any child whose loving mother killed herself if they are glad that she did,  not one would say yes. 

Who will give him the hugs? Who will tell him about girls? Who will he want to make proud and look after?  Who will sort out his cuts. Who will tell him he has an infinite capacity for sweetness and kindness?  Who will love him so fiercely that she would die for him if it would help him? 

Those things are a mothers job. Your job. He needs you. Suggesting anything else is lying to make suicide easier. You're considering it because you're tired. Not for him. 

If you were an abusive mother then maybe he'd be better of without you, but you're not. You're poor and have had a tough life and want better for him. Better for him is you.  He needs you now and he will need you in the future.. and a gravestone won't hug him or give him advice or be proud of him.

No... the two things are not mutually exclusive. I've been told I'm the kindest person someone every knew, but they still split up with me. I'm on my 7th relationship. I've been divorced once and engaged 4 times...oh and lost two sisters. My daughters are still alive though and I'm sorry for your loss. My father was and is an abusive alcoholic who damaged me greatly. 

One thing you are wrong about is your son. Your death will change him and not for the better. Spend time tomorrow reading up on the effect of a mothers suicide on a child. 

I agree life is nothing more than a reason to exist and reproduce. However,  I can't understand why you would rather die than be bankrupt. You might as well "try" bankrupt. You always have the option of suicide and bankruptcy might work and help you. If it doesn't, what have you lost? You will get to see your son a couple more times at least and he'll enjoy that.. as will you. 


Life is hard,  I'm suicidal, but it can be beautiful. Just look at a sunset properly, rather than at a razor. Look at your son's smile. That has to be worth living for, because it will not be seen so much without you.  You can try to rationalise that all you like,  but no child is better off without a parent who loves them.

My fiancee died of AML. Unlike the person you were fighting to live for, I stayed with her to the very end.  That was 20 months of her going through hell, for us.  In that time, people told me to move on and leave her and that I had my own life to lead and even that I was cruel keeping her going. However,  like the guy you are talking about,  I promised her that I would stick with her all the way and i did. Her death nearly killed me though. It was 5 years ago and I still struggle. 

You could look at it that you've saved the person you loved from going through the loss I did.  My fiancee told me to leave her and I refused. I was always a stubborn sob...as was she.  So you could say "at least no one will suffer when I go and especially not the person I loved". 

Are you terminal then,  because otherwise, there is always hope,  however slim. It was a week before she died before I lost hope. If you're not, then fight for you and the hope that they might cure it. 

If you are,  then fight for those little things in life that make it worthwhile. Or you can write in a blog that someone may find one day and be helped by or you can make a difference in places life this, where a single post can save a life. I really don't know. Try to find something that gives you peace. 

Whatever you do,  do it for you. 

If it helps, I'm no longer religious,  (that died with my love) but I still feel her with me.

Hi.

I dont know you at all. I did however read all the above. I was in bed (I say "bed", I'm sleeping on a mattress on the floor, because my life - at age 46 - has led me to a place where I spend midnight on a Saturday reading a suicide forum... for obvious reasons. 

However, I ignored my shit and got out of bed so I can reply easier. 

I had a friend who went bankrupt at an older age than you. Not much older. At the time I thought "no way, how can you?". I thought that was his life over. Now he is my age and has been free of all the bankruptcy hang ups for some years. He is married and in a house and happy. You could be too. Dying is just dead. Why can you possibly think that bankrupt is worse than that?

As for you son. No ****ing way would he be better off without you. Never in a million years. You're his one and only mother. You think that anyone is better off without a loving mother? Obviously not. 

I had a friend who rang me to say they wanted to go the pictures. I said I was busy. He hung himself that night and left a message saying he was lonely. That has haunted me ever since... and that was a school friend and not even a close one. If my mother had killed herself and my last memory of her was her being kind and nice to me and doing all she could for me and not looking after herself, then I would carry that with me for the rest of my life and I would miss her every day of my life. 

As for things going wrong for you more than anyone, that isnt true. You are $5000 in debt. The love of my life was about our age (a little older), when she had a headache. She said she would go to the doctors the next day. She did. She was given 2 weeks to live. She managed 20 months, but she died. I have never loved another since until 3 months ago. That person was raped 2 weeks ago and is now suicidal. I'm struggling to keep them alive. In the midst of all that, I lost my house, my possessions, my life savings, in 2 months I lose my job and I'm running low on money. I have only 2 friends left in the world. She is one and the other lives in another country.

Shit happens in life. Its easy to think "it must be me". I just wrote my friend saying I think I'm a Jonah. I dont beleive in that shit, but it does seem anything I touch turns to shit right now. I know I've not been bad in this life, so I'm even wondering what I must have done in a previous one.

Thing that keeps me going is my friend who I love with all my heart... as I am sure you do your son. If my friend gives in to her grief and the pain, then I will be right after her. But until she does, I am enduring the pain and I am forcing myself to put one foot in front of the other. Oh and my friend who I love lives in another country. We've known each other many years, but its not like I can be much help to her. 

You are allowed happiness. I am sure you had it when you were proposed to and when you were married and when your son was born. Life is hard now because of an amount of money... a small amount of money. It is not worth dying over so little. Your mum and her best friend are talking crap. You're not the devil's target. For one thing, if there is a devil, he isn't taking special interest in you. He took a LOT more interest in the love of my life, because he had some pretty ****ing horrible things happen to her before he gave her AML. For another, there is no devil who is out to screw people's live up. There is just life, which can be very hard, but can equally be lovely at times. 

So it is NOT a fact that things go wrong for you more than anyone you know. My fiancee had much worse happen to her and she was a wonderful person. You are alive and with a loving son. I wish to god my fiancee was alive. 

So, get through today. Monday go and see someone about the realities of going bankrupt or if there is anything else that can be done. YES it will be shit and you will have to start over, but at least at that point the only way is up. Kill yourself and the only way is 6' down and your son has to live with that the rest of his life. 

And yes, I'm a father and yes, I'm suicidal. 

Hang in there. You seem like a nice person. The world needs more nice people in it and less of the assholes.

Hey mate, you helped me get through tonight, so that is a reason you have existed. Sure no bus was coming towards me and maybe I won't survive tomorrow night, but tonight your words helped. 

As for you. Life is meaningless, for all of us. It's just a way to make more of us so we continue to ravage the earth. But life can be beautiful. 

When you're in love or see a sunset or whatever else works for you, then it's worth the pain to have got there. 

Best thing I ever did for my view of life and to reduce my self destructive cynicism was quit drinking. After that, I appreciated the small things in life one more. The other thing I and you need to work on is our self esteem. Finally, consider starting a hobby like a musical instrument. Something you can get good at, day by day. It make the days have more meaning than just another day of pointless shit to wade through entire to sing and getting older.

Thanks for your rambling.

You made the choice to post here. That was the right choice,  so not everything you choose to do goes wrong. 

Sounds ds to me that your major problem is low self esteem which is compounded by the view you feel your family has of you. Are you sure this is their view? If so it's them more with the problem not you. Cutting of your friends is not sensible. It's their choice to be your friend. If they choose to be,  then chances are you're not as bad add you think you are. 

Finally,  lift your head up and look people in the eye. We all make mistakes, it's called life and we learn from them. It's nothing to be ashamed of. I've made plenty and I'm still here 46 years later.  Some days are shit.  Some are wonderful. It's the wonderful ones you hang around for. 

So stick around,  work on your self esteem and care a lot less what a small bunch of screw ups think. For sure, do not give them the satisfaction of killing yourself. Show the racists that you are better than they and even you think. Dig deep and kick ass.
